map.均值 = (Σ dᵢ)/7；中位数 = 升序后第 4 个值；极差 = max −: Mean = (Σ dᵢ)/7; median = the 4th value after sorting; range = max − min; total = Σ dᵢ
map.对固定 7 个数值快速给出集中趋势与离散程度：均值为总和除以 7；中位数取升序排: Gives central tendency and dispersion quickly for exactly 7 values: the mean is the total divided by 7, the median is the 4th (middle) value after sorting ascending, the range is the maximum minus the minimum, and the sum of all values is shown as well. Handy for classrooms or for describing a set of data quickly.
map.中位数：排序后中间值: Median: the middle value after sorting
map.本版使用7个固定输入，便于快速计算。: This version uses 7 fixed inputs for fast computation.
map.计算任意分位数（四分位、十分位等）。: Computes any quantile (quartiles, deciles and so on).
map.同上 P90 位于第 7.2 位≈7.2，即 90% 数据低于约 7.2。: On the same data P90 sits at position 7.2 with a value of about 7.2, meaning 90% of the data fall below roughly 7.2.
map.位置非整数时常用线性插值（如 NumPy 默认），不同软件（Excel/TI 等: Non-integer positions usually take linear interpolation (NumPy's default), although Excel, TI calculators and other software differ slightly.
